VIPCOO H2 Electric Dirt Bike | High-Performance Off-Road Electric Motorcycle | 3500W Power | All-Terrain Adventure Bike

Take your riding experience to the next level with the VIPCOO H2 Electric Dirt Bike, engineered for riders who demand power, durability, and full off-road capability. Built with a high-torque motor, long-range battery, and professional-grade suspension, this electric dirt bike is designed for both teens and adults seeking real outdoor adventure.

⚡ Powerful 3500W Electric Motor

Equipped with a 48V 3500W high-performance motor, the VIPCOO H2 delivers instant torque, fast acceleration, and impressive hill-climbing ability. Whether you're riding off-road trails, dirt paths, or uneven terrain, this bike provides strong and stable power output for a thrilling ride every time.

🔋 Removable High-Capacity Battery

Powered by a 48V 23Ah removable lithium battery, the H2 offers 34-43 miles on a single charge. The detachable design allows for convenient charging and easy battery replacement, making it perfect for extended outdoor adventures.

🏔️ Advanced Off-Road Suspension System

Front hydraulic suspension

Rear nitrogen shock absorber

This dual suspension setup significantly reduces impact from rough terrain, delivering a smoother, more controlled riding experience even on rocky or uneven surfaces.

Designed for maximum grip and stability, the tire configuration ensures excellent traction across mud, gravel, sand, and mountain trails.

🛑 Enhanced Safety & Control

Front & rear hydraulic disc brakes (oil brakes) for strong, responsive stopping power

Automatic power cut-off when braking, enhancing safety control

Protective chest guard bar design for improved rider protection

🧠 Smart Display & Riding Features

Stay fully informed with a clear display showing:

Speed & battery level

Gear position indicator

Error code alerts

MPH / KMH switchable system

Reverse mode

Three-speed riding modes

Adjustable riding settings for beginners and advanced riders

🏗️ Durable Frame & Comfortable Design

Strong iron frame construction for durability and stability

Ergonomic one-piece cushioned seat for long-distance comfort

Compact, modern design with a clean off-road aesthetic

Modular structure for easier assembly and maintenance

🌧️ Built for Real Outdoor Conditions

IPX4 water resistance rating

High ground clearance for water crossings and rugged terrain

Designed for all-weather riding performance

130 cm – 185 cm (4.3 ft – 6.1 ft)
Perfect for teens, beginners, and adult riders looking for an entry-to-mid level electric dirt bike.

🚀 Why Choose VIPCOO H2?

The VIPCOO H2 combines high power, long range, rugged suspension, and smart riding features into one versatile electric dirt bike. It’s built for riders who want more than commuting—it's built for real adventure.
